title: Doctor order (internal event)
description: Topic borj/{ward}/{bed}/order. INTERNAL: stored in the encrypted event log only and NEVER published on MQTT, because it is free clinical text about a patient. Written by a doctor through the REST API (the remote on-call doctor's instruction to the ward, ADR 0008). It is a message to the nurses: it never changes a prescription, an assignment or a score (safety invariant 1), and it never reaches the family components (invariant 2).
